title: The Momager Files
teaser: Loretta kept every receipt. Every single one.

news.headline: Contract, Page 14
news.body: The management deal: 25% forever, including Sarah's "likeness after death." Loretta drafted it herself, on Sarah's 16th birthday.
news.hook: A sticky note on page 14: "She'll never read this far."

news.headline: Voice Note, Saturday, 11:48 PM
news.body: Loretta to her sister, the night before brunch, slightly breathless: "Tomorrow I'm finally getting what I'm owed."

news.headline: The Policy
news.body: The $3M life policy, with premiums paid from Sarah's account, was raised by Loretta this summer. Last month Sarah filled in a beneficiary change form.

news.headline: The Receipts Folder
news.body: "What I'm owed" was $60K Loretta spent on Sarah's first demo and first lease when Sarah was 17, and she kept every receipt. Sarah's statements also show $30K a month to Loretta, plus Jett's "loans."
news.hook: The last receipt is a florist order for white roses, placed Sunday at 11:02 AM.

news.headline: What Loretta Kept
news.body: The roses were a brunch peace offering with a card, "I'm sorry too. Mom," never delivered because she stormed out. Sarah had drafted a reply promising her mother 10% for life. One more line in Sarah's statements: a $25K monthly "tithe" to Radiant Harbor, which stopped the day she ordered the audit.
news.hook: Loretta reads the draft and asks if it's legally binding.
